property_summary: For any caller and any nonzero ETH amount sent to C via its receive(), the reference contract accepts the payment and increases depositsCount (so a funded low-level send to C succeeds and leaves depositsCount > 0 for that caller/amount), whereas the mutant that unconditionally reverts inside receive() will cause such funded calls to fail (revert) for some inputs, violating that receiving funded transfers succeeds and updates depositsCount.
change_summary: Add a revert after the require so receive always reverts and depositsCount does not change.
